Measured at 2026-10-21T13:45:18.100051+00:00; HEAD `ea5c1386dc4882801e2fc44df5f73d907fd8894a`.
The working tree contained the parent's separate R18 MIR/pass edits (status.before.txt); reviewed bytecode probe-owner files were clean before and after. R18 is not exercised by these helper-level timings.

## Environment and cache

See environment.json, hardware.txt, rustc.txt, cargo.txt, dependency-features.txt and build.stderr.log for the complete captured environment.
- Toolchain: `rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13)`; `cargo 1.99.1 (5f94df478 2026-08-27)`; LLVM version: 23.1.1.
- Machine: 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K, 16 physical cores / 24 logical CPUs, 68447940608 bytes physical RAM reported; os: Windows 10.0.26300 (Windows 11 Professional) [64-bit].
- Host logical CPUs: 24. Build parallelism: Cargo default, no -j override. Timing: one test thread, serial algorithms, no Cargo/rustc/Clippy/rustdoc process present at timing boundaries.
- Workspace release profile, native x86_64-pc-windows-msvc. Root manifest only overrides profile.dev; release therefore uses normal Cargo defaults (opt-level 3, no debug info, debug assertions/overflow checks off, no LTO, default codegen units). No custom target/profile/job/flags settings were supplied.
- Observed Cargo test artifact profile/features: `{"opt_level": "3", "debuginfo": 0, "debug_assertions": false, "overflow_checks": false, "test": true}` / `[]`. kagari-bytecode declares no features; dependency features are captured separately.
- Existing target/release cache was present: True. Build duration 43.315 s is excluded from timings. No cache flush, CPU pinning, power-policy changes or process-priority changes. Prepared fixtures are reused/reset outside timers and code/data/allocator caches are warm, not cold-start measurements.

## Frozen protocol

- Availability range counts/batches: 1/16384 (small control), 16/2048, 256/64, 4096/2. Each operation builds the index once, queries 2D PCs in reverse order and releases the index. Old scan performs the same reverse queries. One disjoint length-one range per even PC; max overlap one, exactly D outputs. Source ranges reverse-ordered; slots differ by range to make exact output validation meaningful.
- Solver block counts/batches: 1/4096 (small control), 16/256, 128/8, 1024/1. Both numeric-forward and permuted/reverse chains; one-block control has only one layout. B-1 edges, one bitset word, parameter slot 0, terminal use only, no debug ranges. All reachable; initialization begins at top and liveness at bottom.
- Exactly one explicit full-batch warmup per algorithm/condition, then seven full-batch samples. Algorithm order alternates each round; warmup starts with old. Samples below are normalized per operation; samples.json and timing.stdout.log retain original batch nanoseconds and warmup timings. Fixed batching improves resolution without changing fixture sizes.
- Fixture creation, cloning, reachability, resets, output-buffer reservation and correctness assertions are outside the timers. New algorithm-owned index/DFS/queue/bitset allocation and deallocation remain inside. Availability output clear/push/extend and batch loop/black_box overhead are timed symmetrically. Solver iteration drops/replaces states as the original/production algorithms do.
- Timed availability paths return actual build/query charge counters and scan predicate inspections; emitted slot vectors are checked exactly. Query charge equals node visits plus emitted outputs, so query_nodes is derived by subtracting exact output count. Build charges include sorting/traversal work units, not a claim that each unit is one comparison.
- Timed solver baseline is a test-only copy of original pre-R16 fixed_points (see pre-r16-flow.rs), including original update ordering and work/cancellation charges, plus a real block-visit counter. Before timing it matches the existing uncharged reference helper's exact facts and visit count. New fixed_points includes postorder construction, directional queues, actual cfg(test) visit counters and all production charges. Every timed batch checks final initialized/live vectors and work/visit counts.

## Interpretation and limits

- These are bounded helper-level, matched native release measurements, not source compilation, artifact loading, runtime execution or end-to-end latency promises. Old paths are source-inspected test-only baselines compiled alongside new paths, not measurements of an old checkout/binary.
- R17 intentionally isolates the shared capability: caller charging is represented by deterministic counters, without verifier CancellationToken or full input-vector/allocator plumbing. The old scan is the previous filter membership operation; its inspection counter is extra instrumentation. Sparse max-overlap-one workloads do not measure dense output costs or all interval shapes. Index construction/lifecycle is included, not amortized away.
- R16 includes the original and new charging/cancellation machinery and real visits, but remains cfg(test), with synthetic one-word chains and no graph/metadata admission or point validation. The existing uncharged oracle is a correctness check, not the timed baseline. Ordinary/async end-to-end differences, wider bitsets, cycles, dense joins and cancellation latency are outside these timings.
- Mechanism evidence matches the expected scope: at D=4096, 33554432 scan inspections become 139887 build + 143365 query work units, with 98304 bytes of index scratch. At B=1024, original forward/permuted visits are 1049600/1048576 versus 2048 directional visits; charged work is 7345150/7337984 versus 21499. The reversed layout makes old initialization propagate slowly while forward layout makes old liveness propagate slowly. These are chain-specific observations, not a universal linear solver bound.
- Small controls expose setup overhead; ratios below one are regressions for those controls, not failures to be hidden or new optimization work. Batching amortizes the clock but not algorithm setup. This single-machine run has seven samples, no affinity/frequency control or confidence intervals; retain all samples/ranges and do not generalize precise ratios to other hardware/platforms.
- No additional optimization, production/permanent-test edits, documentation edits, staging or commits are part of this measurement. The driver removes exactly its appended suffixes and checks byte-for-byte original restoration; any unexpected source change stops removal rather than overwriting it.

## Reproduction and artifacts

From repository root run `uv run python target/ae-final-measurements/run_measurements.py`. The driver appends the saved probes to their existing test modules, captures environment/features, runs `cargo test --release -p kagari-bytecode --lib --no-run --message-format=json` once, then invokes the resulting executable directly with `ae_final_measurement --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1`. It finally removes only its own exact suffixes. Do not run other Cargo builds/tests during timing. The script refuses to start timing if cargo/rustc/Clippy/rustdoc is active and records boundary process snapshots.

- `availability-probe.rs`, `solver-probe.rs`: exact temporary reproduction payloads.
- `availability-tests.before.rs`, `solver-tests.before.rs`, `source-restoration.json`: original bytes and restoration/hash evidence.
- `pre-r17-flow.rs`, `pre-r17-allocation.rs`, `pre-r16-flow.rs`: source-inspected baseline snapshots obtained with git show; no checkout/reset.
- `samples.json`, `timing.stdout.log`, `timing.stderr.log`: all measured samples, warmups, counters, assertions/test outcomes.
- `environment.json`, toolchain/hardware/feature/build logs: environment and build provenance, separate from timing.

def capture(command, name, timeout=60):
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout)
    text = result.stdout + result.stderr
    (OUT / name).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{command!r} failed ({result.returncode}); see {name}")
    return result

    query = "SELECT Name,ProcessId,CommandLine FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name = 'cargo.exe' OR Name = 'rustc.exe' OR Name = 'clippy-driver.exe' OR Name = 'rustdoc.exe'"
    result = capture(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command", f'Get-CimInstance -Query "{query}" | ConvertTo-Json -Compress'], name)

            'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR', 'CARGO_HOME', 'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN', 'RUSTFLAGS',
            'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL', 'CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG',
            'CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO', 'CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS', 'CARGO_INCREMENTAL',
            'CARGO_BUILD_TARGET', 'RUSTC_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER',
        ]},
    }
    meta['head'] = capture(['git', '--no-pager', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], 'head.txt').stdout.strip()
    capture(['git', '--no-pager', '--no-optional-locks', 'status', '--short'], 'status.before.txt')
    capture(['rustc', '-Vv'], 'rustc.txt')
    capture(['cargo', '-Vv'], 'cargo.txt')
    capture(['powershell.exe', '-NoProfile', '-Command', "Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors | Format-List; Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object Manufacturer,Model,TotalPhysicalMemory | Format-List; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,BuildNumber | Format-List"], 'hardware.txt')
    capture(['cargo', 'tree', '-p', 'kagari-bytecode', '-e', 'features'], 'dependency-features.txt')
    installed = []
    restoration = []
    try:
        for source, payload, backup_name in PAIRS:
            before = source.read_bytes()
            if b'BEGIN AE FINAL TEMPORARY' in before:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Temporary marker already present in {source}; refusing to overwrite')
            suffix = b'\n' + payload.read_bytes()
            (OUT / backup_name).write_bytes(before)
            source.write_bytes(before + suffix)
            installed.append((source, before, suffix))
        started = time.perf_counter()
        built = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'test', '--release', '-p', 'kagari-bytecode', '--lib', '--no-run', '--message-format=json'], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', timeout=600)
        meta['build_seconds'] = time.perf_counter() - started
        (OUT / 'build.stdout.jsonl').write_text(built.stdout, encoding='utf-8')
        (OUT / 'build.stderr.log').write_text(built.stderr, encoding='utf-8')
        print(built.stderr, flush=True)
        if built.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Release build failed; see build logs')
        artifacts = [json.loads(line) for line in built.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
        artifact = next(item for item in artifacts if item.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and item.get('executable') and item['target']['name'] == 'kagari_bytecode' and item['profile']['test'])
        meta['artifact_profile'] = artifact['profile']
        meta['artifact_features'] = artifact['features']
        meta['executable'] = artifact['executable']
        (OUT / 'environment.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        competing_builds('build-processes.before-timing.json')
        print('Build complete; timing only two ignored probes serially with one test thread.', flush=True)
        measured = capture([artifact['executable'], 'ae_final_measurement', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1'], 'timing.combined.log', timeout=180)
        (OUT / 'timing.stdout.log').write_text(measured.stdout, encoding='utf-8')
        (OUT / 'timing.stderr.log').write_text(measured.stderr, encoding='utf-8')
        print(measured.stdout, flush=True)
        competing_builds('build-processes.after-timing.json')
        rows = [json.loads(match.group(1)) for match in re.finditer(r'AE_RESULT (\{[^\n]+\})', measured.stdout)]
        assert len(rows) == 11, len(rows)
        assert '2 passed; 0 failed' in measured.stdout
        (OUT / 'samples.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        summarize(rows, meta)
    finally:
        for source, before, suffix in reversed(installed):
            current = source.read_bytes()
            if current != before + suffix:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected source change in {source}; refusing to overwrite; inspect backup/suffix manually')
            source.write_bytes(current[:-len(suffix)])
            restored = source.read_bytes()
            assert restored == before
            restoration.append({'path': source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'sha256_before': hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(), 'sha256_after': hashlib.sha256(restored).hexdigest(), 'exact_restoration': True})
        (OUT / 'source-restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps(restoration, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    capture(['git', '--no-pager', 'diff', '--check'], 'diff-check.txt')
    print('Exact source restoration confirmed. Results: target/ae-final-measurements/summary.md', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Replay the existing bounded R18 probe once, preserving warmups and order."""
import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TARGET = ROOT / "target"
TESTS = ROOT / "crates/kagari-mir/src/passes/compaction/tests.rs"
OWNED = [
    "crates/kagari-mir/src/passes.rs",
    "crates/kagari-mir/src/passes/compaction.rs",
    "crates/kagari-mir/src/passes/compaction/tests.rs",
    "crates/kagari-compiler/src/tests/passes.rs",
]


def run(args, timeout=180):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=timeout)


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def build_processes():
    return run([
        "powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
        "Get-Process cargo,rustc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessName,Id | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0",
    ], timeout=10).stdout.strip()


before = {path: (ROOT / path).read_bytes() for path in OWNED}
assert TESTS.read_bytes() == (TARGET / "ae03-compaction-tests-before-raw-probe.rs").read_bytes()
saved = (TARGET / "ae03-compaction-matched-probe.rs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
marker = '#[test]\n#[ignore = "temporary AE03 matched release operation probe"]'
fixtures, suffix = saved.split(marker, 1)
assert fixtures.strip() == TESTS.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip(), "Probe fixtures changed"
probe = marker + suffix
old_record = '''                if sample != 0 {
                    if legacy {
                        before.push(elapsed);
                    } else {
                        after.push(elapsed);
                    }
                }'''
new_record = '''                if legacy {
                    before.push(elapsed);
                } else {
                    after.push(elapsed);
                }'''
assert probe.count(old_record) == 1
probe = probe.replace(old_record, new_record)
assert probe.count("        before.sort_unstable();\n        after.sort_unstable();\n") == 1
probe = probe.replace("        before.sort_unstable();\n        after.sort_unstable();\n", "")
start = probe.index('        println!(\n            "N={size}')
end = probe.index("        );", start) + len("        );")
probe = probe[:start] + '''        println!("AE03_RAW n={size} d={dead} old_ns={before:?} new_ns={after:?}");''' + probe[end:]
source = TESTS.read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip() + "\n\n" + probe
probe_path = TARGET / "ae03-compaction-raw-probe.rs"
probe_path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

build_command = ["cargo", "test", "-p", "kagari-mir", "--lib", "--release", "--no-run", "--message-format=json"]
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
head = run(["git", "--no-pager", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
toolchain = run(["rustc", "-Vv"]).stdout
processes_before = build_processes()
assert not processes_before, "Competing cargo/rustc process before build: " + processes_before
try:
    TESTS.write_bytes(source.encode("utf-8"))
    build_started = time.perf_counter()
    built = run(build_command)
    build_seconds = time.perf_counter() - build_started
    (TARGET / "ae03-compaction-raw-build.log").write_text(built.stderr + built.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
    artifacts = [json.loads(line) for line in built.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
    executables = [a["executable"] for a in artifacts if a.get("reason") == "compiler-artifact" and a.get("target", {}).get("name") == "kagari_mir" and a.get("profile", {}).get("test") and a.get("executable")]
    assert len(executables) == 1, executables
    processes_before_measurement = build_processes()
    assert not processes_before_measurement, "Competing cargo/rustc before measurement: " + processes_before_measurement
    measurement_command = [executables[0], "--ignored", "--exact", "passes::compaction::tests::operation_probe", "--nocapture", "--test-threads=1"]
    measured = run(measurement_command, timeout=30)
    raw_output = measured.stdout + measured.stderr
    (TARGET / "ae03-compaction-raw-output.log").write_text(raw_output, encoding="utf-8")
    print(raw_output, end="")
finally:
    TESTS.write_bytes(before["crates/kagari-mir/src/passes/compaction/tests.rs"])

assert all((ROOT / path).read_bytes() == content for path, content in before.items()), "Owned source changed"
rows = []
pattern = r"AE03_RAW n=(\d+) d=(\d+) old_ns=(\[[^\]]+\]) new_ns=(\[[^\]]+\])"
for match in re.finditer(pattern, raw_output):
    size, dead = map(int, match.group(1, 2))
    row = {"total_entries": size, "dead_prefix_entries": dead, "retained_suffix_entries": size - dead, "algorithms": {}}
    for name, encoded in zip(["legacy_reverse_sort_remove", "production_stable_compaction"], match.group(3, 4)):
        values = ast.literal_eval(encoded)
        assert len(values) == 6 and all(isinstance(value, int) and value >= 0 for value in values)
        row["algorithms"][name] = {
            "warmup_ns": values[0], "samples_ns": values[1:], "all_iterations_ns": values,
            "median_ns": statistics.median(values[1:]), "min_ns": min(values[1:]), "max_ns": max(values[1:]),
            "charged_work_per_iteration": dead if name.startswith("legacy") else 6 * size,
            "logical_column_element_relocations_per_iteration": 3 * dead * (size - dead) if name.startswith("legacy") else 6 * (size - dead),
        }
    rows.append(row)
assert [row["total_entries"] for row in rows] == [16, 256, 4096]
result = {
    "schema": "kagari-r18-bounded-compaction-samples-v1", "captured_at_utc": started,
    "head": head, "source_state": "uncommitted AE03 compaction on top of committed R17/R16",
    "capture_reason": "Previous probe output kept all five sorted measured samples but discarded warmups; this single replay preserves both warmups and acquisition order.",
    "time_unit": "nanoseconds", "workloads": rows,
    "method": {
        "sizes": [16, 256, 4096], "affected_blocks": 1,
        "shape": "D=N/2 dead prefix followed by L=N/2 retained suffix; synthetic LoadConst instructions with unique spans/scopes",
        "iterations_per_algorithm_per_size": 6, "warmup_iterations": [0], "measured_iterations": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        "acquisition_order": "For each size in ascending order, iteration 0 through 5, legacy first then production; arrays preserve this order, without sorting.",
        "timer": "std::time::Instant::now / elapsed().as_nanos()",
        "timed": "Legacy reverse sort and three Vec::remove calls per dead entry, or actual production compaction::apply; includes Work charges/cancellation checks and tail cleanup.",
        "excluded": "Module/template construction and clone, removal Vec allocation, assertions/origin enumeration, printing, final fixture destruction, compilation.",
        "cache_state": "One explicit warmup per condition/size; immediately cloned allocations before each timed operation; no cache flush.",
        "serial_execution": {"build_before_measurement": True, "test_threads": 1, "competing_cargo_rustc_before_build": processes_before, "competing_cargo_rustc_before_measurement": processes_before_measurement, "parent_coordination": "Parent agreed no concurrent Cargo until worker returns."},
        "profile": "workspace release", "features": "default", "target_directory": "default target", "parallelism": "Cargo default; no jobs override; one test thread",
        "relocation_metric": "Exact source-derived logical column element relocations, not hardware counters: old 3*D*L, new 6*L for this prefix/suffix shape.",
        "limitations": "Sub-microsecond values are timer-resolution-sensitive; only operation timings, not source/artifact preparation or end-to-end compiler/runtime results.",
        "build_command": build_command, "build_seconds": build_seconds, "measurement_command": measurement_command,
    },
    "environment": {"rustc_vv": toolchain, "os": "Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26300", "cpu": "Intel Core i9-12900K", "physical_cores": 16, "logical_processors": 24, "ram_approximately_gib": 64},
    "probe": {"source_path": "target/ae03-compaction-raw-probe.rs", "source_sha256": sha(source.encode("utf-8")), "full_source": source, "runner_path": "target/ae03-compaction-sample-runner.py", "runner_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "build_log": "target/ae03-compaction-raw-build.log", "raw_output_log": "target/ae03-compaction-raw-output.log", "raw_output": raw_output},
    "restoration": {"all_four_owned_files_byte_identical": True, "temporary_test_append_removed": True, "source_sha256_before": {p: sha(b) for p, b in before.items()}, "source_sha256_after": {p: sha((ROOT / p).read_bytes()) for p in OWNED}},
    "production_algorithm": {"unchanged_from_prior_source_inspection": True, "source": before["crates/kagari-mir/src/passes/compaction.rs"].decode("utf-8"), "sha256": sha(before["crates/kagari-mir/src/passes/compaction.rs"])},
    "previous_run_recovered": {"provenance": "Earlier tool output in the conversation; measured samples were sorted before printing, warmups were not printed.", "warmups_available": False, "sample_order": "sorted, not acquisition order", "measured_samples_ns": {"16": {"old": [300, 300, 300, 300, 400], "new": [100, 100, 200, 200, 200]}, "256": {"old": [17300, 17300, 17300, 17400, 20200], "new": [2000, 2000, 2000, 2100, 2400]}, "4096": {"old": [10074500, 10188200, 10478000, 10545900, 10866100], "new": [32500, 33500, 34000, 40200, 149500]}}},
}
output = TARGET / "ae03-compaction-samples.json"
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print("Saved", output)
print("Compaction SHA256:", result["production_algorithm"]["sha256"])
print("Restoration: all four owned files byte-identical; temporary append removed")

sdk.method:
# AE03 current-only native release SDK integration measurement

## Scope and identity

Accepted run on 2026-10-21, current working tree at HEAD
`ea5c1386dc4882801e2fc44df5f73d907fd8894a` **plus the existing uncommitted AE03
compaction implementation**. This is not a clean-HEAD measurement.
`implementation-at-build.patch`, `status-before-build.txt` and
`source-input-hashes.json` record the inspected working-tree state. Input hashes
were identical immediately before/after accepted timing. No production code,
permanent tests, repository documentation, manifests or lockfiles were edited by

## Routes and timing boundaries

Each stage uses Rust `Instant`, retaining the returned value until after the
elapsed timestamp. Results/errors/assertions, CSV formatting, metadata inspection
and ordinary later destruction are outside the corresponding phase timer. Work
intrinsic to an API, including its internal cleanup, remains inside that API's
timer. SourceFile/options/context construction is outside compile/execute timers.
Rows are buffered in memory; files and the final stdout message are written only
after all measured iterations. No compilation/build time is mixed into SDK phases.

1. **direct**: separately timed default engine construction, then the real
   `KagariEngine::compile_to_program(source, PreparationOptions::default())`,
   then separately timed runtime construction, `load_program`, first `execute`.
2. **staged_source**: a different fresh engine, timed `compile_source` for source
   parsing/checking, then timed `prepare(&checked, PreparationOptions::default())`.
   `source_lower_prepare` includes MIR lowering/optimization/verification,
   bytecode lowering/verification, and executable adoption. The public SDK API
   does not expose independent timers for those internal steps; no finer split
   or subtraction from another route is inferred. Runtime construction, linking
   and first execution are also individually timed on this product.
3. **artifact**: a different fresh engine, timed `compile_to_artifact` (source
   checking + lowering + explicit portable artifact construction), separately
   timed `artifact.records().to_bytes(artifact.definitions())`, separately timed
   `BytecodeArtifact::from_bytes(&bytes)`, then separately timed
   `PreparedProgram::from_artifact(decoded, &compatibility, &cancel)` with defaults.
   This last stage is independent artifact admission, identity import, bytecode
   verification/preparation and supplied native-input validation, not source
   checking. The original exported artifact remains alive until the route ends.
   The final serialized artifact is retained as `sample.kbc` (939,139 bytes).

For every route: runtime construction is `engine.runtime(context.clone())`,
linking is `runtime.load_program(&program, Default::default())`, and first
execution is `runtime.execute(&loaded, ProgramEntry::Main, &[], &context)`.
The result is rooted through the returned execution report and read/asserted as
`Value::I32(42)` outside the execute timer. There is only one execution per newly
loaded runtime. Engine construction is reported separately, never hidden inside
compile or linking times. Staged attribution is a separate compilation, not a
claim that phase medians add exactly to the separately observed direct median.
